nonimplication: L2 density and distributional faithfulness of Gaussian translates do not imply form-core density because endpoint evaluation is not L2-continuous
categorical_role: restriction j* sends global forms to packet forms; form-core density is the conservativity condition required for j* to reflect nonnegativity
